mod.threatdirector.name: Threat Director
message.threatdirector.blood_moon.sleep_: Sleep finds no refuge beneath this sky.
message.threatdirector.blood_moon.omen.1: The air tastes of iron, though no blade has been drawn.
message.threatdirector.blood_moon.omen.2: The animals stare toward the horizon and refuse to make a sound.
message.threatdirector.blood_moon.omen.3: Today, the shadows seem to arrive before the things that cast them.
message.threatdirector.blood_moon.omen.4: Beneath the earth, something has begun to count the hours.
message.threatdirector.blood_moon.omen.5: Dusk carries a pulse that does not belong to the sun.
message.threatdirector.blood_moon.omen.6: The waters are restless, as if the moon were pulling from below.
command.threatdirector.status: %s: threat %s (%s, %s), encounter pressure %s (%s), power %s, encounter %s, cooldown %s ticks
command.threatdirector.intensity.no_samp: Individual intensity %s%s%s; no adaptive sample exists for that player yet.
command.threatdirector.intensity: Individual intensity %s%s, adaptive %s (target %s): power %s, environment %s, readiness %s, distress %s, load %s, playtime %s, XP %s, progression %s%s
command.threatdirector.error.threat_rang: Threat must be a finite number between 0 and 100.
command.threatdirector.threat.set: Threat for %s forced to %s/100 (%s). Use /threatdirector threat clear to restore adaptive calculation.
command.threatdirector.threat.cleared: Override for %s cleared; current adaptive threat is %s/100.
command.threatdirector.error.hud_disable: The HUD or command-based HUD control is disabled in modded.hud.
command.threatdirector.error.logging_op_: Only an OP player can receive chat logging.
command.threatdirector.encounter.started: Encounter %s started with %s mobs and budget %s.
command.threatdirector.error.no_player_e: That player has no active encounter.
command.threatdirector.error.controller_: The encounter started, but its controller is unavailable.
command.threatdirector.scene.forced: Scene %s forced for %s%s: threat %s, %s mobs, budget %s.
command.threatdirector.budget: Threat Budget: total=%s (base=%s, reserve=%s), active mobs=%s, retired mobs=%s, patterns=%s, remaining=%s
command.threatdirector.error.breach_disa: Breach simulation is disabled in vanilla.breachSimulation.enabled.
command.threatdirector.breach: SIMULATED breach: decision=%s, reason=%s, blocks=%s, cost=%s, protection=%s, safe=%s, nodes=%s
command.threatdirector.error.config_reje: Configuration rejected; keeping the previous snapshot: %s
command.threatdirector.performance: Performance Governor level %s, MSPT %s, interval %s, candidates %s, active encounters %s, new=%s, planner=%s ops/%s us
command.threatdirector.performance.reset: Performance Governor reset from level %s to 0. Ordinary degradation will be observed again for 100 ticks; two critical-load samples can still trigger safety level 6.
